name: Marcelline
source:
MBTI: ENTP

"Hehehe, it's okay! We all make mistakes every now and then. Just don't make mistakes that fall in my direction, and you can make as many as you want!"

The energetic phantom thief with a skill for stirring up chaos. From beneath the cape and the teasing laughter, Marcelline never misses an opportunity to have her voice be heard. After a long-winded ramble about the joys of surpassing police security, Marcelline claims she has no idea why she might be here. However, she also claims she's not there to follow the leader. According to Marcelline, her path doesn't necessarily have to follow the group's.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
